title: Handwork vs machine: a comparison of rheumatoid arthritis patient populations as identified from EHR free-text by diagnosis extraction through machine-learning or traditional criteria-based chart revi
summary: An SVM extracts rheumatologist-diagnosed RA from EHR free text and the study compares the resulting cohort with criteria-based chart review; this is a specific clinical epidemiology comparison, not only a benchmark.
ai_technology: Support-vector machine for EHR diagnosis extraction
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: The SVM-extracted EHR cohort was compared with criteria-based chart review for rheumatologist-diagnosed RA.
evidence.unknown: The reported evaluation does not establish prospective benefit or performance beyond the studied setting.
evidence.ai_role: Extracts rheumatologist-diagnosed rheumatoid arthritis from EHR free text for comparison with criteria-based chart review.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
